REC-001	Xotic	AC Booster	Original	2002-09	Chronology	Xotic's own history dates AC Booster to September 2002 as one of the Tremendous Trio that established the brand's effects identity.	VERIFIED	https://xotic.us/about-us/	Use month-level chronology where the builder supplies it; do not collapse AC Booster into the later BB Preamp family.
REC-002	Xotic	RC Booster	Original	2002-11	Chronology	Xotic's own history dates RC Booster to November 2002 and describes it as a transparent clean boost with more than 20 dB of available boost.	VERIFIED	https://xotic.us/about-us/	Strong builder-level chronology anchor for early-2000s Xotic.
REC-003	Xotic	BB Preamp	Original	2005-01	Chronology	Xotic's own history dates BB Preamp to January 2005 and describes its range from clean boost to high-gain overdrive.	VERIFIED	https://xotic.us/about-us/	Firm month-level introduction evidence.
REC-004	Analog Man	King of Tone	Ver. 3	2004	Generation	Analog Man documents a Version 3 King of Tone in June 2004, created in response to demand for independent DRIVE controls for each channel.	VERIFIED	https://www.analogman.com/manuals/PDFs%20%28may%20be%20older%29/kingtonever3.pdf	Treat Ver.3 as a discrete generation; the builder also dates the first King of Tone sales to November 2003.
REC-005	Analog Man	King of Tone	Original	2003-11	Chronology	Analog Man states that the King of Tone was first sold in November 2003 and quickly required a waiting list because demand exceeded production capacity.	VERIFIED	https://www.analogman.com/kotdelay.htm	This is unusually strong first-sale evidence and should outrank generic retrospective listings.
REC-006	Catalinbread	Super Chili Picoso	Original	2003	Builder origin	Catalinbread identifies 2003 as its founding year and Super Chili Picoso as the first Catalinbread-branded pedal, originally sold exclusively to ToneFactor.	VERIFIED	https://catalinbread.com/pages/about	Preserve builder founding year separately from exact first-batch production count.
REC-007	Catalinbread	Super Chili Picoso	Legacy Series	Legacy / later state	Variant	Catalinbread's current legacy page says the original one-knob and sometimes one-toggle Super Chili Picoso passed through many graphical changes and manufacturing processes.	VERIFIED	https://catalinbread.com/products/super-chili-picoso-legacy-series	Important external-identity clue: graphics and manufacturing process changed repeatedly while the family identity persisted.
REC-008	EarthQuaker Devices	Hoof	Original	2007	Chronology	EarthQuaker states that Jamie Stillman released the Hoof as the company's first full-production-run pedal in 2007.	VERIFIED	https://www.earthquakerdevices.com/about	Use 2007 as firm builder-reported full-production chronology.
REC-009	EarthQuaker Devices	Hoof	Pre-production / development	2006	Provenance	EarthQuaker's documentary traces the Hoof's origin to a November 11, 2006 Black Keys performance and Jamie Stillman's attempt to recreate the observed fuzz character.	VERIFIED	https://www.earthquakerdevices.com/blog-posts/hoof-a-documentary	Keep development provenance separate from first full-production year.
REC-010	Electro-Harmonix	Little Big Muff	Early production	2006	Variant	Contemporary EHX forum documentation records the first few thousand Little Big Muffs in 2006 with a Sustain-Tone-Volume control order, distinguishing them from later units with Volume-Tone-Sustain order.	VERIFIED	https://www.ehx.com/topic/little-big-muff-volume-left-right/	This is exactly the kind of specimen-facing control-layout distinction the archive should preserve.
REC-011	Electro-Harmonix	NYC Big Muff	Revision A	2000	Variant	EHX's historical forum material identifies the 2000 NYC reissue as Version 9 and notes later component-value revisions in 2007 and 2008.	VERIFIED	https://www.ehx.com/topic/big-muff-versions/	Keep revision chronology separate from the broader NYC reissue identity.
REC-012	Electro-Harmonix	Tone Wicker Big Muff	Original	2009	Chronology	EHX historical documentation identifies the Tone Wicker Big Muff as Version 12 and dates it to 2009.	VERIFIED	https://www.ehx.com/topic/big-muff-versions-and-tone-differences/	Useful firm year anchor inside the modern NYC/Russian-derived family history.
REC-013	Mad Professor	Sweet Honey Overdrive	Original	2009	Chronology	Effects Database published the Sweet Honey Overdrive record January 23, 2009 and identifies it as a BJF-designed low-gain overdrive based on the BJFE Honey Bee concept but modified for series production.	VERIFIED	https://www.effectsdatabase.com/model/madprofessor/sweethoney	Preserve BJFE designer relationship and Mad Professor product identity as distinct fields.
REC-014	Strymon / Damage Control	Damage Control	Founding lineage	2004-2009	Builder lineage	Strymon's history states Damage Control Engineering began in 2004, while the team later adopted the Strymon name in 2009 for a fresh line derived from their earlier designs.	VERIFIED	https://www.strymon.net/about/	Important company-lineage transition; do not treat Strymon as simply a renamed pedal enclosure from 2004.
